name: Kusakabe Ami
source:
Elder sister with brother complex. Is part of the kendo club.
She does not show it, but she loves her family.

[spoiler]At first she dislikes Tatsuya, but later she ends having sex with him, despite being in love with Satoru.[/spoiler]
